title: Traditional British Sunday Roast
description: A classic British dish, perfect for a special occasion. Roast lamb is served with a variety of vegetables and gravy.
instructions: Season the lamb with salt, pepper, and rosemary.
Heat oil in a large oven-safe pan over medium-high heat. Sear the lamb until browned on all sides.
Transfer the lamb to the oven and roast for 20 minutes.
Reduce the oven temperature to 180°C (350°F) and continue roasting for 2 hours.
Toss the carrots and potatoes in oil, salt, and pepper. Spread them out in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Roast the vegetables in the oven for 45 minutes, or until tender.
Remove the lamb from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Strain the pan juices and discard the excess fat. Add the beef broth and red wine (if using) to the pan.
Bring the gravy to a simmer and cook until reduced slightly.
Serve the lamb with the roasted vegetables and gravy.
